data.title: Income tax assessment 2024: €1,236 to pay
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterbach issued the 2024 income tax assessment dated 31 December 2025. After withheld wage tax, an additional payment of €1,236.00 is due on 5 February 2026.
data.explanation: This is your tax assessment (Steuerbescheid) for 2024. Tax of €15,130 was set, and €13,894 was already withheld from your pay, so you owe €1,236. Pay it to the tax office's account by 5 February 2026, using your tax number as the payment reference. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the office. The app shows the deadline for it. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.

items.title: Pay additional income tax 2024
items.action: Transfer €1,236 to the tax office account with your tax number as the reference.

items.title: Objection period (Einspruch)
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden.
items.action: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch) against the assessment; file it with Finanzamt Musterbach by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: After the deadline the assessment becomes final.

key_facts.label: Posting date (zur Post gegeben)
key_facts.quote: Hinweis zur Bekanntgabe: Dieser Bescheid wurde am 02.01.2026 zur Post gegeben.
